Brier: Sum_k(probability_k - onehot_truth_k)^2; no division by10, clipping, epsilon or fitting.
common_wrong_competitor: Same nontruth class strictly outranks truth in every original member logit vector; ties excluded; smallest qualifying class is retained server-side.

limits.Qbar_control: Matches aggregate target mass but not per-route target concentration/entropy; assignment and concentration are not separately identified.
limits.cohorts: Frozen from same-seed shared_common before route/permuted prediction collection; overlapping cohorts are not additive.
limits.graph_causality: X is one context; route versus permuted does not establish topology-specific causality.
limits.mechanism: Target differences do not prove acquired competent prediction diversity; report common-competitor rank acquisition and introduced errors.
limits.permutation: Preserves each scored-anchor positive count/class/self/panel; does not preserve public graph degrees.
limits.replication: Three fixed optimizer seeds on one selected graph; no node/member independence.
limits.role: WikiCS split0 development: official validation union stopping masks;5274 nodes
limits.selection_population_caveat: The same complete5274 development population selected the checkpoints and supplies this readout.
limits.stationary_case: Parallel normalized same-class embeddings can have zero positive cosine derivatives despite nontrivial target TV.
